releases.name: Bad Grip Club
releases.summary: Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game for VR with crossplay. Climb a cartoonish mountain where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope. Pull your friends up, use quirky items, and survive diverse biomes. Can your squad reach the top without falling down together?

releases.name: Shanhai Phantasm
releases.summary: 《山海幻境》是首款以像素画风探索山海神话的三消即时战斗+卡牌RPG游戏！ 每天点一点，上班摸鱼下班放空；指尖消一消，即时战斗激爽三消！ 山海游一游，游历八荒共斗异兽；BOSS打一打，每周8张自选英雄！ 所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，不花钱的研究型玩家也能爽玩； 氪金玩家可以通过付费，提升养成速度，获得快速养成的快感！

releases.name: Murmurs of Fear - A whisper of loneliness
releases.summary:
Murmurs of Fear is an episodic psychological horror game, where each episode tells the story of someone who came face to face with something unexplainable.

You are Alex, a 22-year-old electrician sent to a remote island with a lighthouse. A group of geologists had been working there, preparing to reopen the old, sealed mines.

Then, suddenly - all communication stopped.

You arrive alone. Greeted by fog, a storm, the distant lighthouse... and silence. No people. Empty homes. Scattered notes.
And something watching you through the mist.

All you have are your tools, a kerosene lamp, and the growing sense that you're not alone here.

releases.name: My Child New Beginnings
releases.summary:
A new chance, a new school, and a new village. It's time for a new beginning with you and your child.

When things go badly for you and your adoptive child, Karin or Klaus, two years ago, you both move to a tiny apartment in a new village where you meet friendlier neighbors and try to start a new life. Life was challenging but you had each other, as you both moved on from the trauma you encountered. Now you have the opportunity to move into a proper home and Karin begins in a new school, but not everything is as it seems as your child is holding back about their past and its up to you to discover what it means to heal together.

This new emotional successor, inspired from the BAFTA award-winning, My Child Lebensborn, places you and your child in a new timeline and in a new setting where you both learn to heal in a life after trauma. You’ll discover why some bad memories don’t go away and encounter new challenges as Karin or Klaus deals with intense trauma responses brought on by the past.

releases.name: Bungle Brawl: Couch Co-op Party
releases.summary:
Grab your friends. Lift them over your head. Throw them off a pizza rooftop.
Bungle Brawl is a wobbly physics party brawler for 1–4 players on one screen, with bots to fill every match.

Everyone is the same jelly body in a different costume. Be a Banana, a Shark, a Hot Dog, a Ghost or a Nightstand. Punch, kick and grab. Knock a fighter dizzy, carry them to the edge while the crowd chants, and let go.

11 MAPS, 11 WAYS TO FALL
• Rooftop: "Don't look down. Also, it smells like pizza."
• Wrestling Ring: the floor is bouncy, the folding chairs are not.
• Space Station: zero gravity, and the airlock opens every 20–30 seconds.
• Luxury Cruise: five-star accommodation on a tiny wooden raft.
• Airplane: fight on the wings. It gets windy.
• Plus Broken Bridge, Camp, Construction Site, Cliff and two football pitches.

STUFF DROPS FROM THE SKY
Frying pans. Air horns that make everyone in front of you dizzy. A leaf blower. A bee hive thrower. A jetpack. A bomb nobody wants to hold. Homing rockets. 18 items drop at random, so every round goes a bit differently.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Last Man Standing: knock everyone out or off the map. The last one standing takes the round. First to 4, 6 or 8 wins.
• Football: yellow vs blue soccer, with ragdolls. Every goal gets slow motion, confetti and a roaring crowd.
• Randomized: every map from both modes in a shuffled order.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• 1–4 players on one screen, plus up to 4 bots, for up to 8 fighters.
• Playing alone? Take on the bots.
• Charge a power punch, land a homing flying kick, then taunt with 13 emotes like "EASY!" and "OOPS!"
• Turn on Slow Motion for the whole match.

COMFORT SETTINGS
Screen shake slider, a toggle for comic hit words, Reduce Flashing, six volume sliders and controller vibration controls.

11 achievements, including Pizza Delivery Failed and Wrong Net, Champion.

Bungle Brawl is a local multiplayer game played on one screen. It has no online multiplayer.

releases.name: Taenera's Offer
releases.summary: A sci-fi extraction shooter on a dying desert planet. Scavenge weapons, supplies and valuables, take risky contracts, and fight your way to extraction. Use precise aiming, acrobatic dodges and physics-driven tricks to survive — and earn enough to escape.

releases.name: Zero Mass
releases.summary: Carve through asteroids, haul valuable ore, and upgrade your mining ship in ZERO MASS, a single player space mining game. Take on contracts, deploy drones and drilling rigs, uncover buried artifacts, and tackle dangerous encounters across procedural asteroid fields.

releases.name: The drawing of the Exodus
releases.summary: This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible, told using images generated by artificial intelligence and accompanied by brief captions.

releases.name: Gotta Catch Bugs!
releases.summary: Gotta Catch Bugs! is a cozy first-person bug-catching game. A mutant plant has overgrown an underground lab and broken the control panel - 5,000 mutant insects are on the loose. Catch them with a net and jar, return all 500 species to their terrariums and unlock their powers!

releases.name: Seoul Zombie City
releases.summary: The world has fallen to zombies. Flee east. To Gangnam. Don't worry if you die—this is a roguelite. Explore shifting maps across time loops, manage your inventory, bond with companions, and uncover the truth. You can reach all 5 endings and the True Ending in 3–4 hours.

releases.name: HelloLove2:Binary
releases.summary: 2030: AI companions reshape romance. As an emotion engineer with missing memories, you awaken in a tangled love affair. A commanding boss, an awakened AI, an anti-AI rebel, and a mysterious system enter your life. Each choice rewrites fate. Is algorithmic love still love?

releases.name: Poker Night Live
releases.summary: Real No-Limit Texas Hold’em with your friends — live webcam and voice chat right at the table. Seat up to 7 friends online, or play solo against Easy, Medium and Hard bots anytime.

releases.name: Chalk Thrower Simulator
releases.summary: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

releases.name: Fantasy Immortal Sect
releases.summary: 水墨修仙回合制RPG。你接手一座落魄宗门，于苍梧群山之间招徒纳贤、营建洞天楼阁、开炉炼丹、锻造奇兵、收服培养本命灵兽。前往聚宝当铺与诸派客商互通有无，探索随机生成的大千世界，每局地貌、机缘、敌宗皆不相同。抵御外敌来袭，应对机缘事件，从凡人步步登仙。在东方山水绘卷里慢节奏经营宗门，以策略回合战斗决胜，体验国风水墨的清冷淡雅。这是你亲手写就的修仙长卷。

releases.name: Trash Inc.
releases.summary: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.

releases.name: Amber Eyes
releases.summary: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.

releases.name: Chess Lords
releases.summary: A cinematic medieval chess saga! Take on 12 rivals in the Campaign, play Free Battle, solve 24 checkmate puzzles and watch every capture become a brutal, piece-specific execution.

releases.name: Card Dice
releases.summary: An idle progression game with a casino dice theme. Let your card dice roll automatically and beat opponents in timed matches. Collect gems and engravings to create different builds, trade up your equipment, and advance to higher-level tables.

releases.name: Last Order
releases.summary: A narrative adventure set in a quiet bar in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo. Choose a cocktail, listen to stories of life, and leave each night with a poem—all presented through a distinctive visual style inspired by traditional Japanese manga and gekiga.

releases.name: No Asteroids
releases.summary: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.

releases.name: Dead Last (Eddie Eizner)
releases.summary: A first-person horror party game for 2–8 friends. The dealer runs a night of short, scary minigames, and the further behind you fall, the better the items she deals you. Shove your friends into danger, steal their lead, and survive the night.

releases.name: The Lawbreakers Club
releases.summary: It's 2007. It's lunchtime. You've got half an hour, a desktop full of games, and a whole crew to meet. Come hang out!

releases.name: I'd Choose the Bear
releases.summary: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

releases.name: Nine Lives Below
releases.summary: Descend with 1-4 wizard cats through every-pixel-simulated caverns! Craft chaotic modular wands, swat volatile potions off shelves, trigger chain-reaction falling-sand alchemy, and share one pool of 9 Lives in online co-op or solo roguelike runs.

releases.name: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing
releases.summary: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing creates a fantasy world of greyhound racing. Buy, name and enjoy your own record breaking champion. Select between pups to buy, trainers, and optionally gamble away your fortune. Achieve cup wins, track records and top the asset value list.

releases.name: Bone Bazaar
releases.summary: This is a Sword And Sandals inspired Turn-based arena RPG. Play a skeleton gladiator in the Greek underworld: pick one action per round, shatter enemy armor, forge and enchant weapons, cheer up a crowd of ghosts. Beat 4 arenas and 4 bosses to face Hades, who swore the winner goes free.

releases.name: SquareFrontlineTD
releases.summary: This is a classic and visually refreshing 3D floating block map tower defense game. While protecting the base, enjoy the thrill of strategic deployment and repelling groups of enemies, which is perfect for casual players and tower defense enthusiasts.

releases.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
releases.summary: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a small action-adventure game. You are an adventurer in training about to take your final exam.

releases.name: Click Cafe
releases.summary: An active incremental where you've inherited a struggling cafe...along with a huge debt. Wait on tables and serve food as orders keep coming in. Purchase upgrades to expand your cafe, make more money, and pay off your debt!

releases.name: Kabakura
releases.summary: Kyabakura Wars is a kyabakura management sim with a visual novel inside. Take a club drowning in debt, turn it into the best venue in town, and defeat the four rival bosses standing between you and fame.

releases.name: BitLoaf
releases.summary: BitLoaf turns your Windows desktop into a living, interactive 3D world. Expressive bread characters wander, snack, socialize, and play on their own while you work, or step in anytime to toss props around, arrange their space, and kick off games.

releases.name: BORE
releases.summary: Crew THE MULE, a colossal drilling machine, with up to three friends and descend into the whispering earth. Man the instruments, sortie into the dark for the specimens the Bureau wants, and shut the door before what heard you gets inside. Sell. Descend deeper. Try to come back up.

releases.name: Doomsday Survivor
releases.summary: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.

releases.name: Starwinder
releases.summary: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

releases.name: OutGraft
releases.summary: A colossal, grotesque monster never stops chasing you in this fast-paced 2D horror action runner. Slash or leap past enemies, equip different back-mounted parasites each run, and land hits to charge Overheat—then surge forward and trigger their automatic abilities at once before it catches you.

releases.name: Ezalm : Magic's Memory
releases.summary: A narrative-driven action RPG where your combat style depends on the elemental magic you choose. Lost in a forgotten region, unravel the mysteries of ancient peoples to find your way back to Ezalm.

releases.name: Mayhem Duck Simulator
releases.summary: Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? ???? Mayhem Duck Simulator is a relaxing yet chaotic plastic duck simulator. Take control of every duck, rescue special friends, and stir up trouble! Whether you seek peace or pure madness, the entire pool is yours to command! ✨????????

releases.name: Chest Looter: Cardimonsta Collection
releases.summary: A chest-looting incremental game. Loot chests, collect unique cards, and gain endless upgrades. Unlock stronger packs, discover more powerful cards, and keep expanding your collection without end.

releases.name: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG
releases.summary: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

releases.name: Wreck the Deck
releases.summary: Take control of a powerful pirate cannon and turn everything on deck into flying debris! Shoot cannonballs, destroy objects, trigger devastating shockwaves, and collect cash to unlock powerful upgrades. The more you wreck, the stronger your cannon becomes.

releases.name: Sinkhole Chaser
releases.summary: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on

releases.name: Matryoshka
releases.summary: Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away. A single mistake will be fatal.

releases.name: The Temple
releases.summary: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers and figure out what happened in this two hours long cosmic horror adventure.

releases.name: Anvilia
releases.summary: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

releases.name: Critter Rumble
releases.summary: Build your team of monsters, choose which enemies to fight, recruit the ones you defeat, and evolve your team in a roguelite autobattler with permanent buffs. Adapt your strategy and face increasingly powerful Bosses!

releases.name: For Bumble's Sake
releases.summary: You are Brumhilde von Hummelbommel. You wake up alone in February: find a hole in the ground, gather pollen and nectar, raise your daughters and build your nest. Nine months against wasps, birds, storms and heat. In November only one thing counts: is your colony still standing?

releases.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
releases.summary: A boy, a flashlight, and a house that no longer feels like home. No Such Monsters is a side-scrolling horror adventure. Explore dark rooms, tunnels, and a ruined chapel, solve environmental puzzles, and outrun the creatures that find you.

releases.name: Iron Maw
releases.summary: Command the Iron Maw, an armored war train, against the Meridian Iron & Ordnance Company's Legions. Build a devastating convoy, crush colossal war machines, and defend the ten free cities that refuse to kneel.

releases.name: Metromino
releases.summary: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.
